title: Trash
message.playerTurn: Click the stock to draw a card
message.awaitWild: Tap a face-down slot to place the wild
cli.help:
Commands:
  d, draw             Draw the top stock card
  p, place <pos>      Place the wild at <pos> (1-10)
  cpu                 Advance the CPU turn
  r, reset            Restart the game
  log, l              Show action log
cli.errInvalidPosition: Position must be an integer between 1 and 10
tutorial.welcome: Welcome to Trash! Each player has 10 face-down cards (positions 1-10).
tutorial.draw: Draw from the stock and place the card at the position matching its rank.
tutorial.wild: K and Joker are wild — place them anywhere. J or Q ends your turn.
tutorial.win: First to flip all 10 slots face-up wins.
